questions.question: In a merit list, Navjot is 18th from the top and 24th from the bottom. How many candidates are listed?
A row has 53 people. Isha is 17th from the left and Kabir is 14th from the right. How many people stand between them?
questions.explanation: Kabir is 53 - 14 + 1 = 40th from the left; the gap is 40 - 17 - 1 = 22.

questions.question: Preet is 12th from the left and Danish is 15th from the right. Exactly 6 people separate them. What is the minimum possible row strength?
questions.explanation: Danish can be at left position 5 or 19. The totals are 5 + 15 - 1 = 19 and 19 + 15 - 1 = 33; choose 19.

questions.question: Ritu, 9th from the left, swaps with Farhan, 13th from the right. Ritu becomes 26th from the left. What is Farhan’s new rank from the right?
questions.explanation: Total = 26 + 13 - 1 = 38. Farhan occupies left position 9, so his right rank is 38 - 9 + 1 = 30.

questions.question: Tara is heavier than Mehak but lighter than Zoya. Zoya is lighter than Bani. Who is the heaviest?
questions.explanation: Descending order is Bani > Zoya > Tara > Mehak.

questions.question: Sahil stands 21st from the front. He moves forward past 8 people and then back past 3 people. What is his final front rank?
questions.explanation: Final rank = 21 - 8 + 3 = 16.

questions.question: Jasleen ranks 14th among 48 candidates. 5 candidates above her and 7 below her leave. Then 4 new candidates are placed above her. Find her rank from the bottom.
questions.explanation: New total = 48 - 12 + 4 = 40; new top rank = 14 - 5 + 4 = 13. Bottom rank = 40 - 13 + 1 = 28.

questions.question: A night bus leaves Patiala at 22:48 and reaches its destination at 03:17 the next day. It stops for 34 minutes en route. How many minutes is it moving?
questions.explanation: Elapsed time is 72 + 197 = 269 minutes. Moving time = 269 - 34 = 235 minutes.

questions.question: A recruitment camp starts on Thursday. What weekday is its 19th day, counting the starting day as Day 1?
questions.explanation: Day 19 is 18 days later; 18 mod 7 = 4. Thursday + 4 days is Monday.

questions.question: In a mixed row, Simran is 23rd from the left and the 9th girl from that end. How many boys stand to her left?
questions.explanation: There are 22 people before her, including 8 girls. Boys = 22 - 8 = 14.

questions.question: Two rows of 18 seats face each other. Row I faces north and Row II faces south. A is 6th from his own left in Row I. B sits opposite A. C is 4 seats to B’s own left in Row II. What is C’s rank from his own right?
questions.explanation: B is 6th from his own right. Moving 4 seats to B’s left increases the right rank to 6 + 4 = 10.

questions.question: For an interview, Karan arrives 16 minutes early. Noor arrives 27 minutes after Karan, at 10:41. At what time was the interview scheduled?
questions.explanation: Karan arrives at 10:41 - 27 minutes = 10:14. Scheduled time = 10:14 + 16 minutes = 10:30.

questions.question: A station clock is always 11 minutes slow. It displays 17:46. What is the actual time?
questions.explanation: Add the slow error: 17:46 + 11 minutes = 17:57.

questions.question: In a queue, twice as many people stand behind Aman as ahead of him. If he is 13th from the front, what is the queue strength?
questions.explanation: Ahead = 12 and behind = 24. Total = 12 + 1 + 24 = 37.

questions.question: At actual 07:00, a clock is 9 minutes slow. It then gains 3 minutes per true hour. Later it shows 11:03. What is the actual time then?
questions.explanation: Initial display is 06:51; displayed advance is 252 minutes. True elapsed = 252 × 60/63 = 240 minutes, giving 11:00.

questions.question: Leena is 8th from the left and Om is 28th from the left. A person stands exactly midway between them. What is that person’s left rank?
questions.explanation: The midpoint rank is (8 + 28)/2 = 18.

questions.question: An online test starts at 14:35 and lasts 1 hour 48 minutes without a break. When does it finish?
questions.explanation: 14:35 + 1 hour = 15:35; adding 48 minutes gives 16:23.

questions.question: 4 runners finish the same distance. P takes 48 seconds; Q takes 3 seconds longer than P; R takes 2 seconds less than Q; S takes 1 second less than P. Who is second fastest?
questions.explanation: Times are S = 47, P = 48, R = 49 and Q = 51 seconds. Lower time means faster, so P is second.

questions.question: A, B and C initially occupy left positions 7, 19 and 32 in a row of 44. First A swaps with B, then B swaps with C, and finally A swaps with C. What is A’s final rank from the right?
questions.explanation: After the first two swaps, A is at 19 and C at 7. The last swap puts A at 7, so its right rank is 44 - 7 + 1 = 38.

questions.question: 6 workshops P, Q, R, S, T and U occupy consecutive days, one daily. P is immediately before S; R is immediately after S; Q is before P; U is last; T is after R. Which workshop is on Day 4?
questions.explanation: The block P-S-R needs Q before it and T after it, with U last. The only order is Q-P-S-R-T-U.

questions.question: A file is 16th from the top in a stack of 61 files. How many files lie below it?
questions.explanation: Files below = 61 - 16 = 45.

questions.question: In a row, Deep is 10th and Harnoor is 16th from the left. Deep leaves his place and inserts himself immediately after the person originally 20th. What is Harnoor’s new left rank?
questions.explanation: Removing Deep shifts original positions 11 through 20 one place left. Harnoor moves from 16 to 15.

questions.question: Distinct persons X and Y are 17th from the left and 11th from the right. Exactly 3 people lie between them. What is the sum of all possible row strengths?
questions.explanation: Y can be at left position 13 or 21, giving totals 23 or 31. Their sum is 23 + 31 = 54.

questions.question: A tower makes 9 equally spaced strikes in 24 seconds, measured from the first to the ninth. How many seconds will 14 strikes take at the same spacing?
questions.explanation: 8 gaps take 24 seconds, so each gap takes 3 seconds. 14 strikes have 13 gaps: 13 × 3 = 39 seconds.

questions.question: In a merit list of 72, Dev is 21st. The top 12 and bottom 18 candidates are removed. Of those remaining, only candidates at odd-numbered original ranks are selected. What is Dev’s rank from the bottom in this selected group?
questions.explanation: Selected original ranks are 13 through 53 in steps of 2. From 21 through 53 there are (53 - 21)/2 + 1 = 17 selected candidates.
